notes.title: Looking Back and What's Coming Next
notes.content:
Hello riders!

We wanted to take a moment to look back, thank you for being part of this journey, share a sneak peek at what’s ahead and give you update on release timeline.

Looking Back
It’s been just little over two years since DownhillVR launched in Early Access, and what a ride it’s been!

Since launch, we’ve delivered 22 updates, packed with new content, gameplay enhancements, and technical upgrades. Here are some of the highlights:
Free Play mode nearly doubled in size! We started with 13 trails and now feature 25 unique routes to shred. We also introduced a whole new environment - Blackrock Heights, alongside upgrades to our original locations, Mountain Hills and Rocky Ridges, with added rivers, wildlife, and revamped terrainImproved replayability of Free Play and Challenge modes with a progression and completion systemChallenges expanded from just 5 tracks to a solid 20, with specialized tiers like the thrilling “Speedy” categoryRefined bike handling, physics, sound design, haptics, and force feedback for a more realistic and responsive riding experienceRevamped UI and menus for clearer navigation and a smoother overall player experienceSmarter NPC AI, making races more competitive, challenging, and dynamicAdded features like online leaderboards, gameplay stats, achievements, a comprehensive tutorial, and helpful assist messages for newcomersVisual upgrades across the board: enhanced lighting, more detailed environments, new models and materials, and special effectsUnder the hood: multiple engine upgrades, a move to Shader Model 6, plus countless performance improvements, optimizations, and bug fixes
And that’s just the big stuff! If you want the full story, you can always dive into the release notes for each version.

Thank You ❤️
None of this would have been possible without you, our incredible community. Your bug reports, feedback, and suggestions have been vital in shaping DownhillVR, and we’re deeply grateful.

A special thanks goes out to everyone who left a review. At the time of writing, DownhillVR stands at an amazing 95% positive rating on Steam, we’re absolutely blown away and thrilled that you’re enjoying the game.

The stories you’ve shared have truly touched us, from players rediscovering mountain biking after injuries, to those reliving childhood adventures on two wheels, or creating new family memories in Hot Seat mode. These were unexpected, and incredibly meaningful to us.

Once again, thank you!

What’s Coming Next
With the core systems now stable and the game running smoothly, we can finally turn our full attention to the features you’ve been asking for most:
Career Mode and Multiplayer are now our top priorities and in active developmentContinued expansion with new trails and challenge trackFurther improvements to physics, bike control, and handlingSmarter, more dynamic NPC AI for engaging racesOngoing visual upgrades, quality-of-life improvements, and the usual performance and bug-fix updates
There’s plenty on the way,  which brings us to an update on our release schedule

Update on Release Timeline
When we launched DownhillVR in Early Access, we estimated a full release in about two years. Clearly, we’ve gone beyond that timeline.

The journey has turned out more ambitious than expected, especially for our small team of four. Instead of rushing to 1.0 just to meet a date, we’ve chosen to keep improving the game at a pace that lets us do things right.

We’re now aiming for a full release within the next year to year and a half. It’s later than planned, but we’re confident the final result will be worth the wait, and we’ll continue releasing updates along the way.

Thanks again for being part of this journey. Your support means the world to us, and we’re excited to keep moving forward.

Enjoy your ride! 🚵‍♂️

notes.title: Update v0.8.30 is LIVE!
notes.content:

Release Notes:
🕹️ Enhancements

notes.title: Update v0.8.29 is LIVE!
notes.content:
Hello riders! This update is all about making the game run better. We’ve focused heavily on improving performance and fixing issues that could cause stuttering or slowdowns. Along the way, we’ve also added a tutorial for new riders, polished up visuals like grass, snow, and lighting, and squashed a bunch of bugs to help keep your ride smooth and fun. 

Check out what's new:

Release Notes:🆕 New Content
Tutorial: A tutorial has landed to help new riders quickly get up to speed. It's available right after launching the game for the first time via the welcome message, or anytime through Main Menu > Garage > Tutorial.
⚙️ Enhancements
Better Foliage: Grass visuals have been improved with increased density and more realistic wind movement, especially on High and Epic graphics settings.

Ribbon Tapes: Trackside tapes now sway more naturally in the wind and feature updated materials.

NPC AI Improvement: NPC racers now use more of the track width for a more natural racing experience.

Lighting Tweaks in Blackrock Heights: Sunset and night lighting has been enhanced for a more atmospheric look and feel.

Snow Upgrade in Rocky Ridges: Rocky Ridges now features higher-quality snow meshes and textures for a more realistic and immersive ride.
🛠️ Bug Fixes & Optimizations
Performance Optimizations:  

Reduced UI rendering costs that were affecting frame rate, even when elements were hidden.  

Optimized and unified various materials to lower GPU load.  

Improved player and NPC respawn handling to avoid costly performance spikes.

Addressed several causes of unexpected stutters during gameplay, particularly in high-density areas and during specific actions. 

Free Ride on Blackrock Heights: Fixed an issue where Free Ride always started at the same location, ignoring the selected track. It now correctly starts at the chosen position, just like in other ride modes.

Sprint Message (Player Assist): Temporarily disabled in Blackrock Heights, where it often appeared unnecessarily. A smarter, context-aware version is planned for a future.

Torch Placement in Blackrock Heights (Night): Fixed floating or poorly positioned torches that disrupted tracks at night. They’ve now been repositioned properly.


Let us know how the game feels after this update! With the performance improvements in place, you might even be able to turn up your graphics settings a notch or two, give it a try and see how it rides! 

Thanks for riding with us and enjoy your ride! 🎮🚵‍♂️

notes.title: Update v0.8.28 is LIVE!
notes.content:
It’s finally here! The long-awaited new Free Play environment just dropped!

This rugged beast delivers everything you’ve been waiting for: brutally steep terrain, razor-thin lines, and our first double black diamond trail. With four all-new tracks packed into this high-altitude monster, this update cranks up the challenge and takes you to new heights. Throw in visual improvements, performance boosts, gameplay tweaks, and more, and you’ve got yourself a ride worth gearing up for.

Release Notes:
🆕 New Content
"Blackrock Heights" Environment: Rising from sheer rock and wind-scoured peaks. Extremely fast, brutally steep, with narrow, rugged paths and zero forgiveness - welcome to Blackrock Heights. This high-mountain enviroment arrives with three technical black diamond trails and marks a milestone - the debut of our first double black diamond beast!"Highline Slide" Track:  Tight and technical with rugged flow, moderate steeps, and frequent drops. Demands precision from start to finish."Timber Coaster" Track:  Starts with a steep plunge into fast, narrow lines and massive woodwork. Fast, chaotic, and full of tight jumps."Hollow Serpent" Track:  - A twisty, steep technical ride with shifting rhythm. Ending in a huge, committing drop."Downfall Line" Track:  Three trails' worth of danger in one. Deadly fast with brutal steeps and epic length. Heavy braking advised! Good luck :).
🕹️ EnhancementsEnergy Tweak:  You now regain energy even when airborne. More jumping = more airtime = more risk = bigger reward!Challenge Tracks in Caves:  Added atmospheric fog and seamless horizon blending inside caves, making dark descents feel more immersive - and a bit more mysterious.Finish Screen XP & Score for Ride: The finish screen now shows how much XP and score you earned for the ride - right in the player info box.Landscape Materials Blending: Terrain material transitions have been refined for smoother, more natural visuals across all environments.Wooden Structures:  Enhanced detail and realism on wood-based structures, especially on High and Epic graphics preset settings.Cows Mooing: Because realism matters. You’ll now hear cows moo. 🐄 
🛠️ Fixes & OptimizationsNight Condition: Fixed overly dark night scenes where terrain became invisible in deep shadow. Lighting has been rebalanced for visibility without losing that nighttime vibe.Material Optimizations: Removed unnecessary decal support from materials, reducing texture load and improving performance.Player's Bike LOD Fix:  On Epic graphics settings, the player’s bike now loads with the correct level of detail at all times.Mesh Optimizations:  Improved Level of Detail (LOD) and fixed several asset-related issues for smoother visuals and better framerate.Foliage Optimization:  Grass and shrubs now correctly avoid steep slopes, reducing clutter and boosting performance.
Thanks for riding with us! With Blackrock Heights now open and packed with new trails and improvements, we’re excited to see how you tackle the terrain. Keep exploring, pushing your limits, and sharing your feedback! It helps us make DownhillVR even better.

Enjoy your ride! 🚵‍♂️🗻

notes.title: Update v0.8.26 is LIVE!
notes.content:
Riders, get ready! This update is all about making conditions stand out. Each condition now feels unique, with tweaks to visuals, physics, and gameplay to keep things fresh. Given these changes, we’ve also split leaderboards and personal track times by condition for a more competitive and fair experience. On top of that, we’ve improved puddles, materials, and performance for a smoother, more detailed ride. Here's what’s new on the trails!

Release Notes:
🕹️ EnhancementsWater Puddles: More puddles can now be found in appropriate areas based on conditions, with some puddles even turning into ice in colder environments. The puddle material has been improved for better visuals, making them more natural and immersive.Greater Differences Between Conditions: Each condition now has more distinct gameplay differences, including ideal lines, physics tweaks, and updated visuals.Improved Grass Rendering: Grass have been enhanced with better shading and tweaked materials for more realistic environments.Free Play Leaderboards Track Times Split by Conditions: Leaderboards (and personal best times) now track and display times based on the selected condition. Don't worry- your current times are preserved under the Day condition.LOD Tweaks: Reduced pop-in effects and adjusted level-of-detail (LOD) settings to improve visual consistency and detail at different distances.Materials Improvements & Optimizations: Numerous materials have been improved to enhance visuals while optimizing performance.Graphics Settings Presets: Graphics presets have been adjusted for better balance between performance and quality.Jump Button Hold Time: The time required to hold the jump button for maximum jumping power has been reduced, making jumps faster and more responsive.Dynamic Controls Info Screen: Info screen featuring motion controllers bindings now shows bindings for currently used motion controllers. 🛠️ FixesDisappearing Water Puddles: An issue where puddles would vanish when viewed from certain angles has been resolved.Challenge Tracks Culling Fix: Fixed an issue with the culling distance in some challenge tracks, resulting in better performance and smoother gameplay.HP Mixed Reality Menu Button Binding: The menu button on HP Mixed Reality controllers was previously also bound to the SteamVR Dashboard, making it impossible to access the in-game menu. The default binding has now been changed to the "Y" button, resolving the issue.

Thanks for riding with us! With these updates to conditions, leaderboards, and others, we’re excited to see how you tackle the trails. Keep exploring, setting records, and sharing your feedback, it helps us make DownhillVR even better.

Enjoy your ride! 🚵‍♂️

notes.title: Update v0.8.25 is LIVE!
notes.content:
Gear up! We’re thrilled to bring you a fresh update for DownhillVR! This one’s all about smoothing out the ride with essential fixes, performance boosts, and a few tweaks to make your experience even better. While there’s no new trail this time, we’ve fine-tuned everything from respawn systems to visuals and added some helpful guidance for new players. Check out the details below and get ready for a more polished journey down the mountain!

Release Notes:

🕹️ Enhancements & Optimizations

Respawn System Overhaul: The respawn system has been reworked to reduce respawning in inconvenient places, like right before jumps or in the river. Now, both player and NPCs should respawn in better spots, creating a smoother game flow.
Welcome Message: The welcome message for new players has been updated with new graphics for a warmer introduction.
Player Assistance HUD Messages: Additional HUD messages have been added to help new players learn the controls. These messages appear only when the game detects that the player isn’t performing key actions. Messages can be disabled or re-enabled in Settings ] Game.
Performance Optimizations: Various tweaks and optimizations have been applied to improve game stability and performance.
Shader Model 6: We’ve upgraded from Shader Model 5 to Shader Model 6, boosting performance and stability.
Lighting & Shadows: Adjusted lightmass volumes and shadow settings across multiple levels, making shadows crisper and enhancing overall lighting quality.
UI Selector Improvements: Improved the visibility of scroll buttons in the UI.
Leaderboards Tweaks: Leaderboards now use asynchronous loading to improve load times and resolve related bugs.

🛠️ Fixes

Leaderboards on Finish Screen: Fixed an issue where leaderboards would not load on the finish screen. You can now immediately check how you stack up against your friends or the global leaderboard after finishing a run.
Leaderboard Subscreens Discrepancy: Resolved a bug that could cause different parts of the leaderboard screen to load results for different tracks. Now, all subscreens should correctly display the currently selected track’s leaderboards.
Personal Best Time Fix: Fixed an issue where an incorrect time could sometimes be saved as a personal best. This fix addresses the root cause, but any incorrect times already saved will remain. This bug only affected locally saved times, not leaderboard scores.
Material Fixes: Resolved material issues on bushes, pine trees, and other assets that were causing errors and visual bugs.
Skyroad & Pillars: Fixed errors that caused pillars to appear unlit in some cases, ensuring more consistent visuals.
Reflection and Light Capture Fixes: Made various tweaks to reflection and light capture settings, especially in stadium challenge tracks, to reduce performance impacts and improve visuals.
HUD Messages in Time Trial: Fixed an issue where HUD messages wouldn’t appear in Time Trial mode.

Thanks for all your support! We’re committed to making each update elevate your experience, and we hope this one makes every ride feel smoother and more fun.
Enjoy your ride! 🚵‍♂️

notes.title: Update v0.8.21 is LIVE!
notes.content:
Hello riders! Welcome to a brand-new update for DownhillVR, packed with exhilarating new tracks and crucial performance tweaks. While we've had to make some compromises on the visual front to keep your rides smooth, we're committed to continuously improving both performance and graphics. Here’s everything you need to know about this new version.

Release Notes:

🆕 New ContentRise'n'Glide Sprint: Take on Rocky Ridge’s new track with ascending challenge that lead into thrilling descents and spectacular jumps.Chillwind Traverse: Experience swift downhill action on Rocky Ridge, featuring occasional jumps and a variety of terrain to keep you on your toes.Blizzard's Bite: Gear up for an intense short climb on Rocky Ridge followed by a twisting descent packed with sharp turns.Pinpoint Dash: Ready to prove your skills? The first Elite Championship Series Challenge is here, designed to truly test your bike handling.🕹️ EnhancementsAI Tweaks: We've smoothed out the AI pathfinding. Now, your virtual competitors should handle sharp angles better, making races feel more fluid and competitive.🛠️ Fixes & OptimizationsPerformance Enhancements: We've tackled several issues that were causing performance hiccups. In order to ensure a smoother experience, some visual elements like trees and grass have been replaced with less resource-intensive versions. While these changes may affect visual fidelity, they are necessary steps toward achieving better overall performance.Rendering and Graphics: We've fine-tuned hardware targeting settings to maximize performance, ensuring that DownhillVR runs more smoothly than ever.Frustum Culling: We've resolved an issue that occurred on VR headsets with higher FOVs, causing flickering objects near the periphery.
We know that changes in visual quality can be a concern, but these adjustments are vital for maintaining a fluid and responsive gameplay experience. We are dedicated to refining these elements in future updates, aiming to bring the visuals back to their former glory and even surpass it.

Thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm. Your feedback is crucial to our ongoing efforts to make DownhillVR an even better experience.

Enjoy your ride! 🚵

See how you stack up against other riders without having to navigate back to the main menu.⚙️ ImprovementsFences Collision Physics: Fences have been reworked to be more bouncy, enhancing collision realism and adding an extra layer of excitement to your rides.Sweeping Coaster Challenge Trophy Times: The bronze time for the 1st Speedy challenge track has been updated, making it easier for you to progress to subsequent challenges.Enhanced Environment & Visuals: We've improved tree shadows, optimized foliage, and fine-tuned the lighting to create more immersive environments that will captivate you with every ride.Performance Optimizations: Enjoy smoother rides thanks to a variety of performance enhancements, including upgraded tree materials, optimized shadow resolutions, and more efficient static lighting across all maps.Sunset Condition Adjustment: The sunset lighting has been adjusted to slightly reduce brightness, creating a more pleasant and realistic evening riding experience.Size Reduction Efforts: We've taken steps to reduce the game size following the last update's bloating, and we're committed to further optimizations to keep the game as compact as possible.🛠️ Bug FixesShadow Fixes: We've addressed the shadow issues with bushes, ensuring a more coherent visual experience.Horizon Fine-Tuning: The horizon has been simplified for a cleaner and more immersive visual experience, enhancing your sense of depth and space as you ride.Optimized Cave and Stadium: We've optimized the cave and stadium surroundings in Challenges for a more seamless experience, ensuring better performance and smoother rides.PSO Caching Fix:  Addressed an issue with Pipeline State Object (PSO) caching to enhance overall game performance and reduce stuttering.Steam Leaderboards Loading: Resolved a problem that caused increasingly longer load times from the Steam Leaderboards after each ride, improving your post-ride experience.
We're excited for you to experience these updates and continue your thrilling rides in DownhillVR. Your feedback is crucial to us, so let us know your thoughts on the new features and improvements.

Enjoy your ride! 🚵‍♀️

notes.title: Update v0.8.16 is LIVE!
notes.content:
Hello, DownhillVR enthusiasts! We're super excited to bring you the latest update, v0.8.16. This update is brimming with adrenaline-inducing new challenge tracks, significant enhancements, and crucial fixes to elevate your gaming experience. Get ready for an even more thrilling ride in DownhillVR! Here is what you can expect:

notes.title: Update v0.8.15 is LIVE!
notes.content:
Overview
Attention all riders! Our latest update v0.8.15 for DownhillVR is rolling out, bringing with it a series of technical enhancements aimed at refining the core mechanics of your mountain biking experience. This update is heavily focused on physics optimizations, control improvements, and system refinements to ensure a more stable and realistic virtual biking journey.

Release Notes
🕹️  EnhancementsStabilized Physics: Fine-tuned the physics engine to maintain consistent bike behavior across a range of frame rates, ensuring a reliable and smooth experience.Enhanced Terrain Interaction: We've revamped the bike's wheels with a new collision system that improves how you'll feel the ground beneath you, allowing for a more authentic and thrilling ride across diverse terrains.Physics Accuracy: Enhanced physics computation for a more true-to-life representation of G-forces during gameplay.Lighting Optimizations: Improved sky lighting to enhance visual depth and realism across all levels.Automatic Headlight Control: As you ride through the tunnel in the Sandy Massives challenge, your headlights will now automatically turn on and off, adapting to the lighting conditions for a smoother experience.In-game Pause Menu Ride Details: Check out the new pause menu addition that shows you the essential ride info, including environment, track, mode, opponents, and difficulty level, keeping you informed and ready for the challenge ahead.Under-the-Hood Improvements: Implemented a suite of technical tweaks, improvements and changes laying the groundwork for future updates.🛠️ Bug FixesGamepad Turning Precision: Resolved the gamepad jiggling issue to ensure smoother steering and better performance.Sky Visibility: Fixed issues with sky and fog interactions, guaranteeing clear visibility and more defined environmental visuals.Stay Tuned Ribbon: Fixed a glitch where the ribbon over Online Multiplayer didn't disappear when accessing the Hot Seat menu
This update may not come with new tracks or challenges, but it's packed with the necessary technical uplifts to set the stage for more thrilling content in the future. We value your input and are eager to hear how these improvements resonate with your VR biking escapades.

Enjoy your ride!

notes.title: Update v0.8.14 is LIVE!
notes.content:
Hello to our devoted DownhillVR community! We are thrilled to announce the release of the v0.8.14 update. This latest version is brimming with a multitude of bug fixes and enhancements. We've also introduced two exciting new challenge tracks, along with innovative features, all meticulously crafted to elevate and enrich your virtual biking experience. Dive in and explore what we've prepared for you!

Release Notes
🆕 New ContentChallenges: Dive into a two brand-new intermediate challenge tracks Sandy Massives and Jumpgate Journey, offering a unique experience for newcomers and seasoned players alike.Wildlife: Encounter deers and cows near various tracks and trails. These animals not only add to the scenic beauty but also dynamically react to riders when approached closely.🛠️ Bug FixesVR Camera Reset: Resolved a glitch that reset the view to the current HMD position post-loading and during respawn/restart.Bike Riding Stability: Enhanced bike stability to rectify prior inconsistencies.Bike Surface Drag: Eliminated an anomaly where surface drag was applied mid-air, influencing jumps and in-flight dynamics.Landing Dynamics: Made strides in addressing the excessive bike rotation during landings, particularly when only the front wheel makes contact. Although instances might still occur, their frequency should be reduced.Sprinting Dynamics: Deactivated sprinting when airborne for a more realistic biking experience.Respawn Mechanism: Addressed an issue where the respawn option in the in-game pause menu would sometimes be deactivated despite being available.UI Challenge Tiers: Resolved an issue where all locked tiers displayed the message "Complete previous tier to unlock," even if they were empty. They now correctly display the "Coming Soon" message🕹️ EnhancementsForce Feedback: Refined the force feedback mechanism for the steering limits on gamepad.Airborn Alley Tier Change: Moved Airborn Alley challenge track from novice tier to intermediate.Visual Enhancements: Rolled out a slew of material improvements and optimilizations.Time Trial: In the starting screen, the player's name now stands out with a distinct color.UI Challenge Trophies: For challenges, a checkmark now signifies if you've successfully completed a challenge without necessarily beating any preset trophy time.Leaderboard Enhancements: The leaderboard now displays both track and environment names.Thank You Dialog: After completing your maiden ride, we've added a warm 'Thank You' dialog as you return to the main menu.UI Clarity: Introduced 'Stay Tuned' ribbons over the Career mode and Online Multiplayer tiles, offering clarity on the game's current features.
Your feedback remains an essential foundation for our ongoing improvements to DownhillVR. Dive into latest update and let us know your thoughts!

Enjoy your ride!

notes.title: Update v0.8.10 is LIVE!
notes.content:
Overview
We're continuously committed to enhancing your gaming experience, and this latest update is packed with bug fixes, visual enhancements, performance improvements, and new features.

We've ramped up performance through upgraded landscape rendering and optimizations, enabling smoother graphics and a more seamless gameplay. We've also addressed multiple CPU/GPU performance issues to minimize frame drops.

This update brings a more intuitive UI, with track difficulty icons, and an aesthetic overhaul of the landscapes in Novice Challenges. For those craving a addditional challenge, we're excited to introduce a new intermediate challenge track, "Ramp Jump", ready for you to conquer.

Additionally, we've added enhanced ambient rain sounds and a new audio cue for missed checkpoints. You can also monitor your progress with our new gameplay statistics feature.

Lastly, we've resolved several bugs, including the off-center bike respawn issue and irregularities with the multiplayer menu screen. 

Release Notes 
🆕 New ContentNew Intermediate Challenge Track - "Ramp Jump": Gear up for an adrenaline-pumping ride with the newly added challenge track "Ramp Jump". Push your biking skills to the limit with this thrilling new addition to our list of challenges.🛠️ Bug FixesOff-center Bike after Respawn: The issue causing the bike to incorrectly reposition after respawn has been rectified, ensuring a seamless experience.Menu - Multiplayer: The Multiplayer menu screen tiles have been fixed, eliminating the unwanted display of the selected border.⚙️ ImprovementsMenu - Track Difficulty Icons: The UI now includes a new feature displaying track difficulty with distinct icons.Novice Challenges - Landscape Visual Overhaul: Novice Challenge (desert) landscapes have been transformed for a more immersive gaming experience.🚀 PerformanceLandscape Rendering: The use of an adaptive page table for landscape virtual texture has significantly improved game performance, enabling faster, smoother graphics rendering and allowing the use of higher resolution textures.Optimized Landscapes: Performance has been enhanced by removing invisible parts of landscapes in challenges.CPU/GPU Performance issues: The resolution of multiple issues causing frame drops in certain environments leads to a smoother, more seamless gaming experience.🎮 FeaturesEnhanced Sounds: New ambient rain sounds and a special audio cue for missed checkpoints have been added to heighten immersion.Basic Gameplay Statistics: Keep track of your performance with our new basic global metrics feature. We appreciate your continued support and feedback. We look forward to your thoughts and suggestions.

Enjoy the ride!

notes.title: Update v0.8.9 is LIVE!
notes.content:
Overview
In this latest update, we have included a whole host of exciting new features to enhance your gaming experience.

First off, we're thrilled to introduce a completely new challenge track "Jump & Turn". It's a fresh addition to our intermediate challenge tracks. Get ready to conquer new obstacles and compete for the best time!

We know how important customization is, which is why we have added more bike color options! From metallic colors to plastic and flip-flop/chameleon hues, the PeakProwler bike range is now more vibrant than ever. Choose your color and stand out from the crowd!

Keeping track of your game progress is now easier with the integration of Steam Cloud Save. No more worries about losing your progress, as your data is securely stored in the cloud.

In addition, we have introduced the Steam Leaderboards. Compare your best track times with friends and other players from around the world. It's time to show off your skills!

We've also worked on bug fixes and performance improvements. We've optimized shadows, fixed some specific challenge & hot seat mode bugs, and made other under-the-hood improvements for smoother gameplay.

Release NotesContent:New Intermediate Challenge Track: Hone your skills on our newly released intermediate challenge track, "Jump & Turn".Bike Color Options: Ride in style with the introduction of fresh color choices for various parts on almost all bikes, including the PeakProwler X Titanium and PeakProwler X Carbon."Aerial Twistdown" Adjustments: The first intermediate challenge has been fine-tuned for smoother jumps and landings.Features:Steam Cloud Save: Never worry about losing progress with your game data securely backed up via the Steam Cloud Save integration.Steam Leaderboards: Best times for tracks and challenges are now published on the Steam Leaderboards. Check the leaderboards in the Steam Community and see how you stack up against players worldwide.Bug Fixes:
General:
Level Start Transition: We've squashed a bug that was causing the camera to fade in twice at the start of levels.
Hot Seat mode:
AI & Ghost Interaction: Ghosts will no longer provoke unnecessary reactions from AI NPC riders.Distinct Ghost Colors: Every ghost now has a color that matches its player's in challenges, just like in Hot Seat - Free Play.Visibility of All Ghosts: We've resolved an issue that was causing only one ghost to appear in challenges.
Bike Customization:
Factory Colors: We've rectified the issue with bike factory colors. They are now correctly set and accurately displayed in the menu.Visual Improvements:Improved Lighting: We've fine-tuned the brightness level in the menu environment and in Day/Night scenarios for a more immersive experience.Smoothened Bike Rotation: Tweaks have been made to allow for smoother bike rotation during landings and intense physics changes.Performance:Game Load Optimization: We've resolved an issue that was causing brief frame drops after loading game and menu environments.Shadows Optimizations: Improvements to static shadows, landscape settings for shadows, and foliage shadows contribute to a smoother game experience.Increased Game Stability: We've ensured game stability with backend adjustments, including explicit settings for DX12 and optimization for specific lightmap resolutions.
We value your feedback and are eager to hear about your experiences with these updates. 

Enjoy the ride!
